svg.title: SchedulerJob: who writes which field
svg.desc: A SchedulerJob travels from Dispatch to the scheduler in PlanRequest.pending_jobs and back inside PlanResponse.scheduled_jobs[i].job. Each field group is written by one side.

g.text: Blue groups are set by Dispatch and only read by the scheduler; green groups are written by the scheduler into the copy it returns. The scheduler never sets STATE_SUCCESS.
